events.title: Pope Formosus crowns Arnulf of Carinthia emperor in Rome
events.description: Arnulf of Carinthia, king of East Francia, invaded Italy again and was crowned emperor in Rome by Pope Formosus, but soon went back to East Francia. Formosus's remains were later exhumed and tried in the Cadaver Synod for siding with Arnulf.

events.title: Pope Gregory VII excommunicates Henry IV
events.description: Pope Gregory VII pronounced a sentence of excommunication against Henry IV, king of Germany, stripped him of his royal dignity and released his subjects from their oaths of allegiance. Their struggle led to Henry's penance at Canossa in 1077.

events.title: The Franciscan Girolamo Maschi is elected Pope Nicholas IV
events.description: Girolamo Maschi, a Franciscan, was elected pope and took the name Nicholas IV, the first Franciscan to hold the office. He reigned until his death on 4 April 1292.
events.html: Girolamo Maschi, a Franciscan, was elected pope and took the name Nicholas IV, the first Franciscan to hold the office. He reigned until his death on 4 April 1292.

events.title: Charles VIII of France enters Naples
events.description: After a rapid march through Italy, the French king took Naples almost without a fight. A coalition of Italian states, Spain and the Emperor soon forced him out, but the Italian Wars had begun.
events.html: After a rapid march through Italy, the French king took Naples almost without a fight. A coalition of Italian states, Spain and the Emperor soon forced him out, but the Italian Wars had begun.

events.title: George Washington is born in Virginia
events.description: Born at Popes Creek in Westmoreland County, Washington commanded the Continental Army in the Revolutionary War and became the first President of the United States.
events.html: Born at Popes Creek in Westmoreland County, Washington commanded the Continental Army in the Revolutionary War and became the first President of the United States.

events.title: Spain cedes Florida in the Adams-Onís Treaty
events.description: Spain gave Florida to the United States and agreed a boundary running to the Pacific. In return the US assumed claims of its citizens against Spain and gave up its claim to Texas.
events.html: Spain gave Florida to the United States and agreed a boundary running to the Pacific. In return the US assumed claims of its citizens against Spain and gave up its claim to Texas.

events.title: Battle of Buena Vista begins in northern Mexico
events.description: Zachary Taylor's outnumbered army held off Santa Anna's attacks over two days near Saltillo. Santa Anna withdrew, and Taylor's fame carried him to the presidency in 1848.
events.html: Zachary Taylor's outnumbered army held off Santa Anna's attacks over two days near Saltillo. Santa Anna withdrew, and Taylor's fame carried him to the presidency in 1848.

events.title: US amateurs beat the Soviet Union in the 'Miracle on Ice'
events.description: A team of American college players defeated the Soviet Union, four-time Olympic champions, 4-3 at the Lake Placid Winter Olympics. The US went on to win the gold medal.
events.html: A team of American college players defeated the Soviet Union, four-time Olympic champions, 4-3 at the Lake Placid Winter Olympics. The US went on to win the gold medal.

events.title: Scientists announce Dolly the sheep, the first clone of an adult mammal
events.description: Researchers at the Roslin Institute near Edinburgh revealed they had cloned a sheep from an adult cell. Dolly, born in July 1996, sparked worldwide debate on the ethics of cloning.
